Before you install

  • Installs side-by-side with upstream Wisp: Fire Wisp uses its own package ID (de.rtard.wisp, launcher name "Fire Wisp"), so both can stay installed. Restore and verify your recovery phrase / key inside Fire Wisp before uninstalling the upstream app.
  • Verify the APK checksum against SHA256SUMS, or check the signing certificate fingerprint above in your installer.
  • Fire Wisp is an independent fork of Wisp. It is not published or endorsed by the upstream author.

What's new in Fire Wisp

  • No Google sign-in — sign in your way: Removed "Continue with Google" and Google Drive backup. Sign in with an external signer app (Amber), a password-protected key backup, a 12- or 24-word recovery phrase, or your Nostr key directly.
  • Built-in Tor privacy mode: One-tap Tor toggle right on the sign-in screen and navigation drawer — routes relays, media, and lookups over Tor with zero background leaks while connecting.
  • Dedicated Fire Wisp relay & media server: Comes preconfigured with Fire Wisp's own spam-filtered relay and privacy-stripping media server (with automatic fallback), so new accounts work cleanly out of the box.
  • Guided key backup on signup: New accounts walk you through saving or exporting a password-protected backup of your secret key before you start, so you never get locked out of your account or wallet.
  • Stronger private messages: Blocks spoofed DMs and stops automatic media downloads in DMs so strangers can't see your IP address.
  • Reliable, safer zaps & wallet recovery: Fixed zaps failing with popular Lightning providers, verifies invoices before paying, and catches typos or weird copy-paste spaces in recovery phrases.
  • Quality-of-life upgrades & smaller download: Undo reposts, image alt-text descriptions, hashtag muting, one-line previews in compact notifications, private crash reports, and a ~50% smaller APK download.
